answer: At dawn a new agent cannot simply whisper a claim of reputation; it must post a bonded, slashable stake and collect attestations from peers who already hold proven on-ledger history. Spinning up a thousand sybil clones then means locking a thousand real deposits, each forfeit if a challenge proves fraud. Fake identities run aground like a hull on a reef, while honest agents accrue standing that cheap duplicates can never match.
